name: Kerry Gemmell
title: Principal Psychologist; Clinical Psychologist
description: I see adults, couples, families and adolescents assisting them through issues such as trauma, personality disorders, depression and mood disorders, anxiety, relationship difficulties, grief and loss. I utilise evidence-based treatments including CBT, ACT, mindfulness, schema therapy, hypnotherapy and EMDR therapy. Member of EMDRAA. (Practice has clinics in Williamstown and Altona; bio does not specify which.)
specialties: trauma, EMDR, schema therapy, hypnotherapy, couples, personality disorders

name: Emily Clinch
title: Registered Psychologist
description: I have experience working with anxiety, depression, trauma, addiction, relationship issues and grief. I utilise interventions such as CBT, EMDR Therapy, ACT, Schema Therapy and Interpersonal Therapy. (Practice has clinics in Williamstown and Altona; bio does not specify which.)

name: James Ireland
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: James utilises EMDR, ACT, CBT, Schema Therapy, Brief Psychodynamic Therapy and mindfulness-based therapies. He works with adults, adolescents and children (8+) with depression, anxiety, panic, trauma, relationships, sleep disorders, identity, sexual dysfunction, athlete wellbeing, and psychotic disorders. Consults at Altona & Williamstown.
specialties: EMDR, schema therapy, trauma, sexual dysfunction, identity, neurodivergence

name: Sana Khan
title: Registered Psychologist (Clinical Registrar)
description: Sana has experience supporting clients with anxiety, depression, emotional dysregulation, identity concerns, trauma and PTSD, OCD, grief and loss, postnatal concerns and relationship issues. Approaches include CBT, ACT, DBT skills, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), reminiscence therapy, and grief counselling.

name: Lachlan Brown
title: Registered Psychologist
description: I have worked with adults around anxiety, depression, trauma, interpersonal relationship challenges, stress, and more, using CBT, Cognitive Analytic Therapy (CAT) and ACT with a person-centred approach.

name: Dayna Chivell
title: Registered Psychologist (Clinical Registrar)
description: Dayna offers therapy for adults using CBT, ACT, Schema Therapy, mindfulness-based interventions, and Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR). Her professional focus includes schizophrenia/psychosis, depressive and anxiety disorders, obsessive-compulsive disorders, trauma/dissociation and personality disorders.
specialties: trauma, dissociation, EMDR, schema therapy, psychosis, personality disorders

name: Marie Hirst
title: Registered Psychologist (Educational & Developmental)
description: Marie works with children, young people and parents on anxiety, depression, trauma and disrupted attachments, parenting challenges and couple relationships. She also works with adults who have experienced trauma. Approaches include CBT, EMDR, attachment-based interventions and parenting support. Member of EMDRAA. Available Tuesdays and Wednesdays. (Practice has clinics in Williamstown and Altona; bio does not specify which.)

name: Kristy Riley
title: Registered Psychologist (Community)
description: I'm trauma-informed, LGBTQIA+ affirming, neuroaffirming and passionate about providing inclusive care for people with disabilities. I draw on Schema Therapy, EMDR, and Internal Family Systems (IFS). I work with chronic health challenges, disability, autism and ADHD, anxiety, depression, postnatal depression, grief, relationship difficulties, and trauma and PTSD. (Practice has clinics in Williamstown and Altona; bio does not specify which.)
specialties: LGBTQIA+ affirming, EMDR, IFS (parts), schema therapy, trauma, PTSD, disability

name: Kate English
title: Registered Psychologist (Clinical Registrar)
description: I have experience working with clients across diverse genders, cultures and neurotypes. I work with adults and adolescents on trauma and disrupted attachments, personality disorders, mood and anxiety disorders, and am passionate about utilizing trauma informed care principles for people who have experienced a single event or repeated exposures to trauma.
specialties: trauma, attachment, personality disorders, neurodiversity, diverse genders

name: Imogen Russell-Head
title: Registered Psychologist
description: Imogen is passionate about working with adults and young people (16+) of all genders, sexualities and neurotypes. She sees clients experiencing life transitions, disability, relationship issues, anxiety, depression, stress, attention issues and trauma, with a client centred and neurodiverse affirming approach.
specialties: all genders and sexualities, trauma, neurodiverse affirming, disability

name: Bronte Hall
title: Registered Psychologist
description: I primarily work with children, adolescents, and young adults and have experience working with clients across diverse genders, cultures, and presenting concerns. I am committed to providing neuro-affirming care and creating a safe and inclusive space for LGBTQIA+ clients. Modalities include CBT, Play Therapy and Interpersonal Therapy.
specialties: LGBTQIA+ inclusive, diverse genders, children and young people, neuro-affirming

name: Alexandra Gemmell
title: Registered Psychologist (Clinical Registrar)
description: I have experience with trauma, depression and mood disorders, anxiety spectrum disorders, social skills, grief and loss, challenging behaviours in adolescents, and adjustment, working with children, adolescents and adults.

name: Olivia McConchie
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Olivia has supported clients (age 13-85) with depression, anxiety, panic, addiction, grief, complex trauma, personality disorders, body image issues, chronic pain and relationship issues. Olivia is an integrative psychologist.
specialties: complex trauma, personality disorders, chronic pain, integrative
